summary: The payload inspector inherits RTL text direction, corrupting JSON formatting, indentation, and punctuation layout.

issues.title: Corrupted RTL code formatting
issues.description: Code content inherits RTL direction, causing right-aligned code, misplaced punctuation, and inverted syntax.
issues.evidence: JSON brackets, commas, and wrapped strings are right-aligned and disorganized inside the payload box.
issues.suggestion: Enforce dir="ltr" and left text alignment on the code container.
